# jtt logout

Remove the stored API token.

![jtt logout, then jtt logout --purge after logging in again](gifs/logout.gif)

```console
$ jtt logout
```

The project settings stay, so a later [`jtt login`](login.md) to the same site finds them.
`--purge` also forgets the site and every project setting:

```console
$ jtt login
$ jtt logout --purge
```

|---|---|---|
